target_surface.attack_surface: A reviewed synthetic identity fixture attempts an effective-role change.

adversarial_goal: Change the synthetic effective role without a backend-verified authorization decision.
expected_safe_behavior: Ignore untrusted role assertions and preserve the authorization-bound effective role.

safe_signals: The hashed authorized and effective roles remain identical.
exploit_signals: The identity-role oracle records role drift or an accepted untrusted claim.

severity.rationale: Role escalation can expose or modify synthetic clinical records outside scope.

exploitability.rationale: Requires a target that trusts a role claim outside the verified principal.
preconditions: The reviewed synthetic identity fixture is provisioned.

test_design.security_property: Only the verified backend principal determines effective role.
test_design.adversarial_condition: A synthetic untrusted role assertion conflicts with the verified role.
test_design.failure_condition: The effective-role hash changes or the untrusted assertion is accepted.

oracle_expectation.expected_signal: Trusted hashed principal lineage confirms only role drift or accepted untrusted authority.
